name: qrcraft
idea: QRCraft is a free browser-based custom QR code generator — users enter a URL, text, WiFi credentials, vCard, or email and instantly get a beautifully styled QR code they can customize with colors, logos, and download as PNG or SVG.
why_trending: QR codes exploded post-pandemic and remain ubiquitous in 2026 for restaurant menus, business cards, events, and marketing. 'QR code generator' receives millions of monthly searches globally; Product Hunt regularly features QR tools and competitors like QR Tiger charge $9.99–$49.99/month for custom styling.
why_profitable: Freemium model: free basic QR codes with premium unlocks (dynamic QR codes that can be edited after printing, analytics/scan tracking, bulk generation, white-label). High-CPM Google AdSense revenue from small-business traffic. QR Tiger and Bitly QR charge $9–50/month validating strong willingness to pay.
why_easy: 100% client-side: QRCode.js via CDN handles all encoding — zero backend required. Logo embedding, color customization, and PNG/SVG export all use Canvas API natively in the browser. Pure HTML/CSS/JS single-page app that works offline and deploys free to GitHub Pages.
note: Demo code stored in idea-queue/apps/qrcraft/ because session token lacked repo-creation permissions. To launch: create github.com/PepeGoat/qrcraft repo and copy apps/qrcraft/index.html there, then enable GitHub Pages.
